name: Attack Yokomenuchi
label: Attack · Yokomenuchi — diagonal strike to the side of the head
description: Uke cuts diagonally at the left side of Tori's head with the right hand-blade, stepping through with the right foot, a little out to his right; the cut stops short of the temple. In motion: kamae, the hand raised up and out to his own right (furikaburi), then the step and the cut. Uke walks in from about two metres into it.
